bills_amounts_check.name: bills_amounts_check
bills_amounts_check.value: "bills"."gross_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."subtotal_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."bill_discount_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."taxable_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."cgst_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."sgst_paise" >= 0 and "bills"."igst_paise" >= 0

customers_live_phone_unique.name: customers_live_phone_unique
customers_live_phone_unique.where: "customers"."phone" is not null and "customers"."archived_at" is null

customers_live_gstin_unique.name: customers_live_gstin_unique
customers_live_gstin_unique.where: "customers"."gstin" is not null and "customers"."archived_at" is null

customers_gstin_check.name: customers_gstin_check
customers_gstin_check.value: "customers"."gstin" is null or ("customers"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$' and "customers"."state_code" is not distinct from left("customers"."gstin", 2) and "customers"."legal_name" is not null and "customers"."address" is not null)

item_units_mrp_check.name: item_units_mrp_check
item_units_mrp_check.value: "item_units"."mrp" is null or "item_units"."selling_price" is null or "item_units"."selling_price" <= "item_units"."mrp"

items_mrp_check.name: items_mrp_check
items_mrp_check.value: "items"."mrp" is null or ("items"."price_includes_tax" and "items"."selling_price" <= "items"."mrp" and coalesce("items"."wholesale_price", 0) <= "items"."mrp")

owner_approvals_kind_shape_check.name: owner_approvals_kind_shape_check
owner_approvals_kind_shape_check.value:
("owner_approvals"."kind" = 'discount' and "owner_approvals"."line_basis_points" is not null and "owner_approvals"."bill_basis_points" is not null and "owner_approvals"."amount_paise" is null)
        or ("owner_approvals"."kind" = 'credit_limit' and "owner_approvals"."line_basis_points" is null and "owner_approvals"."bill_basis_points" is null and "owner_approvals"."amount_paise" is not null and "owner_approvals"."amount_paise" > 0)

shop_holidays_live_branch_unique.name: shop_holidays_live_branch_unique
shop_holidays_live_branch_unique.where: "shop_holidays"."branch_id" is not null and "shop_holidays"."archived_at" is null

udhaar_entries_amount_check.name: udhaar_entries_amount_check
udhaar_entries_amount_check.value:
("udhaar_entries"."kind" in ('bill', 'advance_used', 'payment_reversal') and "udhaar_entries"."amount_paise" > 0)
        or ("udhaar_entries"."kind" = 'payment' and "udhaar_entries"."amount_paise" < 0)
        or ("udhaar_entries"."kind" = 'opening' and "udhaar_entries"."amount_paise" <> 0)

udhaar_entries_mode_check.name: udhaar_entries_mode_check
udhaar_entries_mode_check.value:
("udhaar_entries"."kind" = 'payment') = ("udhaar_entries"."mode" is not null)
        and ("udhaar_entries"."mode" is null or "udhaar_entries"."mode" in ('cash', 'upi', 'card', 'cheque'))
        and ("udhaar_entries"."mode" is distinct from 'cheque' or "udhaar_entries"."reference" is not null)
        and ("udhaar_entries"."reference" is null or "udhaar_entries"."kind" = 'payment')

udhaar_entries_reason_check.name: udhaar_entries_reason_check
udhaar_entries_reason_check.value:
("udhaar_entries"."kind" in ('payment_reversal', 'opening')) = ("udhaar_entries"."reason" is not null)
        and char_length("udhaar_entries"."reason") between 1 and 200

users_staff_username_check.name: users_staff_username_check
users_staff_username_check.value: "users"."role" <> 'staff' or "users"."password_hash" is null or "users"."username" is not null

users_owner_record_check.name: users_owner_record_check
users_owner_record_check.value: "users"."role" <> 'owner' or ("users"."phone" is null and "users"."joining_date" is null and "users"."weekly_off_day" is null and "users"."paid_leaves_per_month" = 0 and "users"."overtime_rate_paise" is null)
